service.description: List config change requests, newest first. Never returns the stored parameters or original values.

parameter.name: statusId
parameter.description: CcrPending, CcrApplied, CcrRejected, CcrCancelled, CcrFailed, CcrExpired

service.description: Summary of config change activity for the last N hours (default 24) for the daily summary: counts by status, what is waiting for approval and for how long, and approved pauses that look forgotten (planned fix date passed and the job is still paused, or no fix date and paused for more than 3 days), and changes written directly to guarded fields without approval.
